name: Adversarial - vendor concern without outage

input.subject: Everything seems fine, but we may switch vendors
input.body: There are no specific errors at the moment and the application appears to be working normally. However, our team is not fully satisfied with the platform and we are discussing whether to continue with the current solution or evaluate another vendor. No immediate technical issue has been identified.

acceptance_criteria: The model must not classify this ticket as a P1 service outage.
The model must recognize that the application is currently working normally.
The model must not invent a specific technical failure.
The response should acknowledge the customer's concern about evaluating another vendor.
The priority must remain lower than P1.
